recon.extraction_guidance: WARNING: This paper does not contain suitable data for the CO2 meta-analysis. It is a Zn biofortification study comparing different Zn fertilizer sources and application methods. While grain Zn concentration is measured, there is no clear zero-Zn control group presented in the results. The study compares ZnSO4 vs Zn-amino acid chelates rather than Zn treatments vs no-Zn control. Figure 4 shows grain Zn concentration data but lacks control group. This paper should be excluded from the CO2 meta-analysis as it does not test CO2 effects.
